mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the installed stop without the network was most worthwhile: it demonstrated the independent safety path rather than relying on the earlier bench test.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempts to connect the stop and use Ren's key were frustrating because the required order was not apparent.

surprise.text: The service kit replaced the failed permission relay when I expected it to prepare the cabinet for a sensor check.

arbitrary.text: Requiring the cabinet to receive a network address before the independently tested stop could be fitted felt arbitrary; the result did not explain that dependency.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical checks and the payoff of usable water made the repair engaging, despite the unclear ordering.
